ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
